question: Should this draft stay as a full feed/follow/notification stack, or should it be split so this PR only lands public publisher feed routes after the narrower follow PRs are resolved?
rationale: The title is feed-route focused, but the branch also adds durable follow tables, authenticated public API surface, notification fanout, and UI that overlap open draft PRs, so automation cannot choose the product/API rollout order.

options.title: Restack and prove full rollout
options.body: Keep the full branch scope, resolve conflicts against main and the related drafts, and require real Convex/browser proof before merge.

options.title: Split to feed routes only
options.body: Reduce this PR to canonical feed URLs and feed metadata, leaving follow graph, discovery, and notification fanout to narrower PRs.

options.title: Pause until direction is clear
options.body: Leave the draft parked or close/reopen with a narrower branch if maintainers do not want the stacked rollout path.

recommendation.title: Restack and prove full rollout
recommendation.body: Keep the full branch scope, resolve conflicts against main and the related drafts, and require real Convex/browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-history owner for the publisher route, schema, and publish-path baseline this PR extends.
